items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: they had Porter, trumpet player, Bucket, and all that bunch, they was, and Killdeed they called him, all that bunch was with Joe Roachio.

ctx.x: Well he played saxophone too. But he left here and he went back with, was it Alvin Walters, he went back with, I can't think of them bands, went back to Oklahoma. See they're all from Oklahoma. And they had Porter, trumpet player, Bucket, and all that bunch, they was, and Killdeed they called him, all that bunch was with Joe Roachio. That's where his band comes. And this boy would play all that trumpet, used to be with Count, boy from, I can't think of his name, his daddy used to play with the Creole Serenade,…
Is he any kind of Dwight Newman?
